improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 50% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
improve.coach: It's come up in 40% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Playing forward
tips: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
improve.coach: 30% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one. 90% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason. Shows up in 50% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there. There in 40% of your matches. Build your game around it.

coach.intro: Pull up a chair, BellyTb1. 10 matches of evidence, and I've got thoughts.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
